note: Voices the Voice Engine knows. 'presentation' (female | male | neutral) and 'age' (child | teen | adult | elder) describe how the voice is perceived; 'languages' lists ISO 639 codes the voice may speak ('*' = any). 'verified': false means the attributes are not yet confirmed against an official source or by listening - such a voice can be used, but every use is reported as a warning. Synthetic voices are test tones (no speech) for offline tests only. Piper voices are real speech from local, free models (no request); their dataset licenses differ - see each voice's license. A project can add its own voices (for example prepared recordings) in its casting file.
